{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Quote|I was a navigator on a system-hopper, just a small-time operator, trading along the Shwuy Perimeter and in Parmic sector.|Attributed to a member of the Khuiumin Survivors|<ref name="PP">{{WEGCite|story=Entering 'The Life'|book=Pirates & Privateers}}</ref>}}
The '''Shwuy Perimeter''' was an [[Astrography|astrographical]] location.<ref name="PP" /> It shared its name with the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> as well as the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]], a Colonies [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> traveling through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Shwuy">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|Uviuy Exen system]] on the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]], while {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} designates the [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]. Therefore, the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] must have traveled through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].</ref>

At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a small [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated along the Shwuy Perimeter as well as in<ref name="PP" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]]. Trading there was slow and encumbered by Imperial taxes. The trader vessel's crew, which included a [[Unidentified navigator (merchant starship)|navigator]], eventually turned to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] raids to supplement its income. The crew finally scattered after getting caught by an Imperial patrol during one of its raids, with the navigator eventually becoming a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and supposedly a member of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]]<ref name="PP" /> pirate group.<ref name="PPbook">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shwuy Perimeter was mentioned in "[[Entering 'The Life']]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''. The book was authored by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PP" />
